why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: (1.21.4, re-reviewed for EpicCoreAPI#32) The old inherited verdict (moved to CloudRendererMixin and the AFTER_SKY GlobalSkyboxHook, same effect) was only partly true on 1.21.4, so both handlers are restored here as on 1.21.3. renderClouds HEAD: 1.21.4's lambda$addCloudsPass$6 calls DimensionSpecialEffects.renderClouds before CloudRenderer.render, so CloudRendererMixin alone missed a dimension drawing its own clouds; eca$skipOccludingClouds cancels that lambda at its renderClouds call (the clouds pass is added after addMainPass/addParticlesPass, so CloudGate.occlude is final). renderSky TAIL: 1.21.4 renderLevel calls addSkyPass only when !isFoggyAt (and addSkyPass adds no pass for SkyType NONE, lava/powder-snow or blindness), so the AFTER_SKY handler never drew in the Nether though 1.21.1's TAIL did; and AFTER_SKY fires after a custom renderSky returned true, where 1.21.1 returned before TAIL. eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass adds an eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main just before addMainPass with the FOG_SKY FogParameters (renderLevel's second FogParameters local), skipped when lambda$addSkyPass$12's renderSky returned true (eca$recordCustomSky); GlobalSkyboxHook's AFTER_SKY handler stands down via passOwned. Double rotation confirmed real: 1.21.4 renderLevel does matrix4fstack.mul(frustumMatrix) before building the frame graph, BufferUploader.drawWithShader uploads RenderSystem.getModelViewMatrix() (that stack) as ModelViewMat, and AFTER_SKY's getModelViewMatrix() is that same frustumMatrix, which GlobalSkyboxHook.render also put on its PoseStack -- view rotation applied twice; the pass now starts the PoseStack from identity (vanilla's sky pass also draws with a bare PoseStack). renderEntity HEAD/RETURN and the renderLevel HEAD/RETURN handlers stay (renderLevel signature without LightTexture).
